messages:
alice: Quick heads-up — aiming to deploy API 2.14, runtime 3.7, console hotfix and router header-split during the 02:00 UTC change window tonight. Need version pins, deploybot wave, and clear rollback triggers. Anyone blocking?
ben: I'm good but runtime team flagged two small fixes. I'll pin runtime -> 3.7.2 and run a short canary in staging first.
carla: Console hotfix is ready; release notes updated: https://redwood/release-notes/console-v2026.03.02-draft. Will pin console:v2026.03.02. Important: console depends on API schema 2.14-rc2 — if we fallback to 2.13, console will error on the new /session field.
dinesh: Router header-split needs the header flag `x-rw-experimental` toggled only for canary slices. Plan: 5% initial, then 25%, then ramp if green. Also will drain kv cache TTL after the split. Rollback plan: revert header flag + unpin router image.
ben: @deploybot please schedule wave with sequence [router -> runtime -> api -> console] and 5min observation per step. Can we also keep 2.13 pinned in fallback pool?
deploybot: Scheduled wave 1717554321-01. Sequence: router, runtime, api, console. Canary slices: 5% -> 25% -> 100% (manual). Watchers: @oncall-eve. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 1717554321-01`
oncall-eve: I'll be oncall for the window. My telemetry checklist: p50 latency, p95 latency, 5xx rate, api schema errors, kv-cache miss rate. If 5xx > 0.5% or p95 increases > 30% for 10m, we rollback.
carla: Add a regression check for /session schema in canary. If schema check fails (even 1 failure) block the rollout.
ben: Runtime note — we saw kv-eviction spikes in staging with header split. I'll add a warmup step and set `runtime.kv_evict_threshold=0.6` for the canary.
dinesh: Router quick-rollback path: flip `x-rw-experimental` off and route traffic back to `router:tag=stable`. That should avoid touching runtime or API pins.
alice: Good. Release notes: I'll add a "compatibility" section calling out console's dependency on /session and the header-split behavior. Draft: https://redwood/release-notes/2.14.0-draft
oncall-eve: Please include grafana links + runbook steps (query, threshold, mitigation). I'll paste the runbook snippet into the release notes before deploy.
carla: One more check: DB migrations? None for this release — confirmed.
ben: Ack. Pushing pins now: runtime=3.7.2, api=2.14.0, console=v2026.03.02, router=1.12.5-header-split
deploybot: Pins applied. Wave 1717554321-01 created. Channel will receive deploy updates as the rollout proceeds.
alice: Thanks team — if you see anything weird ping me or @oncall-eve directly. Otherwise proceed with the scheduled window. :rocket:
